verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance platform, so HR-synced onboarding and offboarding checklists are a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents an HR integration, onboarding or offboarding checklists, or training-completion tracking. The nearest items are adjacent features (MDM remote action on offboarded devices, and monitoring of Google Workspace, GitHub and AWS IAM user accounts), and they do not prove that every hire got training or every leaver lost access.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access
